card.name: Word before 'loss of potency'
card.fires_on: The word 'significant' right after 'without' in storage statements, just before 'loss of potency'. Also fires on words or % signs before loss or decomposition terms.

modes.label: Without significant loss
modes.description: 'significant' after 'without' in storage-stability statements for reconstituted solutions.
modes.example: the vials may be stored in a refrigerator for 14 days without<< significant>> loss of potency.

modes.description: A % sign or 'rapid' before a loss or decomposition term in drug mixing text.
